title: Resource-Efficient Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Devices with Dynamic-Circuit Qubit Reuse and Grover-Based Trajectory Search
abstract: arXiv:2509.16002v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A resource-efficient quantum reinforcement learning framework for finite-horizon quantum Markov decision processes is presented, employing dynamic-circuit qubit reuse to reduce the interaction-workspace requirements of multi-step execution. The framework integrates quantum state-transition and reward encoding, dynamic-circuit execution, quantum return evaluation, and Grover-based trajectory search. Its central contribution is a dynamic execution model in which a fixed interaction workspace is reused across sequential agent-environment interactions through mid-circuit measurement, qubit reset, and next-state propagation. For the considered benchmark, this approach reduces the interaction-workspace requirement from 7T qubits under a static circuit to a constant seven qubits, independent of the interaction horizon T. translated_title: 基于动态电路量子比特复用与Grover轨迹搜索的NISQ设备资源高效量子强化学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种面向有限时域量子马尔可夫决策过程的资源高效量子强化学习框架，采用动态电路量子比特复用技术来降低多步执行对交互工作空间的需求。该框架集成了量子态转移与奖励编码、动态电路执行、量子回报评估以及基于Grover的轨迹搜索。其核心贡献是一种动态执行模型：通过电路中间测量、量子比特重置与下一状态传播，使固定的交互工作空间能够在序列化的智能体-环境交互中被重复使用。在所考虑的基准测试中，该方法将交互工作空间需求从静态电路下的7T个量子比特降低至与交互时域T无关的恒定7个量子比特，这相当于三步基准测试中66%的缩减，并将交互工作空间复杂度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向NISQ设备的资源高效量子强化学习框架，通过动态电路量子比特复用与基于Grover的轨迹搜索，将多步交互所需量子比特从随步数增长的7T个降至恒定7个，与交互时域无关。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a resource-efficient quantum reinforcement learning framework for NISQ devices that combines dynamic-circuit qubit reuse with Grover-based trajectory search, reducing the interaction-workspace requirement from horizon-dependent 7T qubits to a constant of 7 qubits, independent of the interaction horizon.
